hints.title: Connected Component Flood Fill
hints.text: Traverse the matrix using breadth-first search to extract connected components of positive values.

hints.title: Component Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate the sum of all cell values belonging to each discovered island component.

hints.title: Divisibility Verification
hints.text: Check whether the accumulated island sum is divisible by k without remainder.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear grid traversal visiting each cell once during component exploration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning cells without marking visited states causes exponential loops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean visited grid prevents revisiting cells.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Perform standard component traversal while accumulating cell values.
